shortDescription: Adds a virtual Ethernet adapter to the virtual machine.

options.name: allow_guest_control
options.description: Flag indicating whether the guest can connect and disconnect the device. If unset, the value is unchanged.

options.name: backing
options.description: Physical resource backing for the virtual Ethernet adapter. If unset, the system may try to find an appropriate backing. If one is not found, the request will fail. Required with I(state=['present']) Valid attributes are:  - C(type) (str): This option defines the valid backing types for a virtual Ethernet adapter. (['present'])    This key is required with ['present'].    - Accepted values:      - DISTRIBUTED_PORTGROUP      - HOST_DEVICE      - OPAQUE_NETWORK      - STANDARD_PORTGROUP  - C(netwo

options.name: mac_address
options.description: MAC address.   This field may be modified at any time, and changes will be applied the next time the virtual machine is powered on.  If unset, the value is unchanged. Must be specified if I(mac_type) is MANUAL. Must be unset if the MAC address type is not MANUAL.

options.name: mac_type
options.description: The I(mac_address_type) enumerated type defines the valid MAC address origins for a virtual Ethernet adapter.

options.name: nic
options.description: Virtual Ethernet adapter identifier. The parameter must be the id of a resource returned by M(vmware.vmware_rest.vcenter_vm_hardware_ethernet). Required with I(state=['absent', 'connect', 'disconnect', 'present'])

options.name: pci_slot_number
options.description: Address of the virtual Ethernet adapter on the PCI bus. If the PCI address is invalid, the server will change when it the VM is started or as the device is hot added. If unset, the server will choose an available address when the virtual machine is powered on.

options.name: session_timeout
options.description: Timeout settings for client session.  The maximal number of seconds for the whole operation including connection establishment, request sending and response.  The default value is 300s.

options.name: start_connected
options.description: Flag indicating whether the virtual device should be connected whenever the virtual machine is powered on. If unset, the value is unchanged.

options.name: type
options.description: The I(emulation_type) enumerated type defines the valid emulation types for a virtual Ethernet adapter.

options.name: upt_compatibility_enabled
options.description: Flag indicating whether Universal Pass-Through (UPT) compatibility should be enabled on this virtual Ethernet adapter.   This field may be modified at any time, and changes will be applied the next time the virtual machine is powered on.  If unset, the value is unchanged. Must be unset if the emulation type of the virtual Ethernet adapter is not VMXNET3.

options.name: vcenter_hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: vcenter_password
options.description: The vSphere vCenter password If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: vcenter_rest_log_file
options.description: You can use this optional parameter to set the location of a log file.  This file will be used to record the HTTP REST interaction.  The file will be stored on the host that runs the module.  If the value is not specified in the task, the value of  environment variable C(VMWARE_REST_LOG_FILE) will be used instead.

options.name: vcenter_username
options.description: The vSphere vCenter username If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: vcenter_validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to C(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.

options.name: vm
options.description: Virtual machine identifier. The parameter must be the id of a resource returned by M(vmware.vmware_rest.vcenter_vm_info). This parameter is mandatory.

options.name: wake_on_lan_enabled
options.description: Flag indicating whether wake-on-LAN shoud be enabled on this virtual Ethernet adapter.   This field may be modified at any time, and changes will be applied the next time the virtual machine is powered on.  If unset, the value is unchanged.
